Discover effortless elegance with our 2Pcs Plus Size Drawstring Wide Leg Pants. Designed with high-grade breathable fabric, tailored modern silhouette, and fine detailing, this piece offers an unmatched fit whether you're dressing up for special occasions or seeking everyday sophistication.

Key Highlights:

  • Ultra-comfortable, premium-feel fabric designed for all-day wear
  • Flattering fit cut to enhance your silhouette
  • Fade-resistant color and durable stitching for lasting quality
  • Effortlessly versatile styling for every season

Care Guide:

Machine wash cold on gentle cycle with similar colors. Do not bleach. Dry flat in shade. Iron on low heat if needed.
